name: Allison
source:
A visual novel adaptation of the light novel series of the same name by Keiichi Sigsawa.

Allison is an adventure series set in a world containing one continent (extending roughly from the Equator to 60 degrees North latitude) which is divided down the center by a towering mountain range and a huge river. The industry and technology of the world are roughly equivalent to Europe in the 1930s. Due to the geography, two cultures developed on either side of the divide, and at the time the story begins, the cultures have been at war on and off for hundreds of years. The bloodiest conflict yet began thirty-five years before the start of the story; both sides are so exhausted by the conflict that an uneasy armistice is signed after some five years of fighting. Aside from a brief conflict over the jurisdiction of the river, resulting in the formation of a buffer zone on either side, this peace has largely been unbroken. The east side of the world is known as Roxche (ロクシェ Rokushe?), though formally the region's name is the Roxcheanuk Confederation. The entire region comprises sixteen countries which all speak a common language. The west side is known as Sou Beil (スー･ベー･イル Sū Bē Iru?), though formally the region's name is the Allied Kingdoms of Bezel Iltoa. The region comprises the two kingdoms of Bezel and Iltoa which both serve to bring together a small number of countries under a common language different than that of the eastern region. There are far more blond-haired people in the West than the East.

At the beginning of the first novel, Allison, a pilot in the Roxche Air Force, has come to visit her childhood friend Wilhelm ("Wil" for short), who has remained at school over his summer break to continue his studies. While traveling in the countryside near the school, the two encounter an old man well-known to Wil's schoolmates as a teller of tall tales. Nevertheless, he captures their interest with his talk about a "treasure" which, if found, is said to be able to put an end to the war. No one would believe him that the war between the countries could ever end, so no one listened to him. When the old man is abducted and taken over to Sou Beil, Allison and Wil steal an airplane and chase the abductors across the river into the next region. Fortunately, the two were raised as orphans by a woman who came from the West, and thus can speak both languages.

[from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Allison_(novel_series)]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
《艾莉森》是时雨泽惠一同名轻小说系列的视觉小说改编作。

《艾莉森》系列是一部冒险作品，舞台是一个大陆（大致从赤道延伸至北纬60度），中央被高耸山脉和巨大河流纵向分割。这里的工业和技术水平大致相当于20世纪30年代的欧洲。由于地理环境，分界线两侧发展出不同文化。故事开始时，两种文化已经断断续续交战数百年。最血腥的冲突始于故事开始前35年；双方都因战争疲惫不堪，交战约五年后签署了不稳定的停战协议。除了一场关于河流管辖权的短暂冲突，并由此在两侧形成缓冲区外，和平基本未被打破。东部被称为洛克谢，正式名称为洛克谢亚努克联邦，由16个使用共同语言的国家组成。西部被称为苏·贝伊尔，正式名称为贝泽尔·伊尔托亚联合王国，由贝泽尔和伊尔托亚两个王国组成，旗下聚集着少数使用不同于东部语言的国家。西部的金发人远多于东部。

第一部小说开始时，洛克谢空军飞行员艾莉森前去探望青梅竹马威廉（简称“威尔”）。威尔暑假期间留在学校继续学习。在学校附近乡间旅行时，两人遇见一名老人。威尔的同学都知道他喜欢讲夸张故事。尽管如此，老人谈到的“宝藏”仍引起了他们的兴趣。据说只要找到宝藏，就能结束战争。没人相信国家之间的战争会结束，因此无人听他的话。老人被绑架并带到苏·贝伊尔后，艾莉森和威尔偷走一架飞机，跨过河流追赶绑匪，进入下一个地区。幸运的是，两人由来自西部的女性作为孤儿抚养长大，因此都会说两种语言。

[译自[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Allison_(novel_series)]Wikipedia[/url]]
